messages:
anya-docs: Small ask  we need a tiny migration checklist + 3-snippet smoke job for the v1 -> v2 notice. Keep it minimal.

rui-sdk: I'll sweep SDK and samples for client.v1 and replace with v2 patterns. Quick grep: `rg "client.v1" --hidden || true`

jade-qa: Propose CI job docs/migrate-quick that runs py/js/go snippets, asserts exit code, and checks embedding dims for rwd-embed-128. Save logs to artifacts/docs/migrate-quick/1761234000.

mark-web: Web will add a temporary redirect /v1/* -> /docs/migrate-v2 (302). Ticket WEB-9312 opened.

ci-bot: CI job docs/migrate-quick queued by @jade-qa

jade-qa: Run complete: 3/3 passed. Node streaming example needed a tiny tweak for new callback signature; patched in docs PR. Artifacts: artifacts/docs/migrate-quick/1761234000/report.txt

anya-docs: Great. Draft banner: "Redwood API v1 retires 2026-05-15. Migrate to v2: /docs/migrate-v2". Owners: docs @anya-docs, SDK @rui-sdk, CI @jade-qa, web @mark-web. Target: merge fixes by EOD.
